methodology.bootstrap: 500 deterministic percentile bootstrap draws, grouping free/batch variants by exact checkpoint stem; not a causal or family-clustered interval.
methodology.cohorts: Jan 2–Mar 31 entrants in 2025 and 2026; 180-day restricted mean time to first sustained exit. Jan1 omitted in both years. Returns after exit are recorded separately.
methodology.demand: Observed cumulative tokens are minimums since first observation. Each absent-model day has a possible upper bound min(rank50 tokens, other tokens); missing whole days make the full-window upper bound unavailable. Bounds cannot be summed across models because they share other.
methodology.endpoint: First day of at least 28 consecutive observed calendar days absent from the overall daily top 50; this is popularity-window exit, not zero demand or model retirement.
methodology.forecast: Historical first-episode top10-open landmarks at comparable age (plus/minus 14 days), one per checkpoint stem excluding the target. Applied to today's ten leading reviewed open-weight API IDs; target is overall top50 exit. Reentry forecasts suppressed. No individualized accuracy or calibrated prediction intervals claimed.
methodology.population: Public text token traffic on OpenRouter. Registry openness is reviewed current status, not proof of availability of weights on every historical day.
methodology.survival_censoring: Administrative censoring 27 days before cutoff leaves 28 days to confirm an exit. Models already present on the first dataset day are excluded from fitted survival and matched entrant cohorts.
methodology.unit: Exact ranked OpenRouter model_permaslug; dated versions and free variants remain separate.
methodology.units: All token totals are decimal integer strings; requests, input/output mix, compute, cache reuse and global lifetime demand are not observed.
